name: Plinky Expander
source: https://plinkysynth.com/docs/manual (Expander section) ; cross-check https://modulargrid.net/e/thonk-plinky-expander (4HP Thonk version); ModularGrid panel image (checked 21 Oct 2026) (jack count matches)
notes: A/B/X/Y are bipolar -5V to +5V CV outputs of Plinky's modulation (A/B follow knobs, X/Y accelerometer). MIDI IN is TRS (type A or B); MIDI OUT is TRS type A. USB (B on the 4HP DIY version, C on the 2HP revision) not listed. Official docs now describe a 2HP revision of the 'classic 4HP DIY Plinky Expander'; both have the same jack set per sources, panel labels not visually confirmed.
